title: The Crop tool tells you which corner you are about to drag
goal: Crop mode draws eight handles around the crop box, and the pointer stays a plain crosshair over every one of them. Everywhere else on the canvas a handle now shows the matching resize arrows before you press, so Crop is the one place left where you have to press and find out.
notes: The cue is decided in CanvasPointer.cue (PhotonzCore, pure) and applied in CanvasView.pointerCue / refreshGrabCursor, which currently guard on tool == .select. The crop press is CanvasView.mouseDown, the branch that builds CropDrag from Handles.hit(at:frame:cropRect:zoom:screenTolerance:8). Cursor images come from CanvasCursor.cursor(for:transform:). Left out of the every-handle pass on 2026-09-03 because Crop is its own mode with its own pointer, so whether the crosshair should give way is a judgement of its own.
acceptance: Resting on any of the eight crop handles shows the resize arrows that match that corner or edge.
Resting inside the crop box, or anywhere off a handle, shows the Crop tool crosshair as it does today.
The playtest walk that reads the pointer covers the crop handles.
